Dylan Park: Idea: 2-email reactivation blast for dormant signups (30-90d) that leads with a tiny benchmark stat + 1-click sandbox. Keep copy short and test subject lines. Sound good?
Aisha Khan: Yes. Targeting: users with >1 signup day but <5 API calls in 90d. Segment by initial intent (docs vs trial).
Marco Ruiz: Send cadence: Day 0 announce (stat + sandbox), Day 3 follow-up (short how-to + poll). Poll asks: Which matters most? [Cost][Latency][Security] with trackable links.
Faye Chen: Draft subjects: A) "Still curious? See Redwood cut inference costs" B) "A 5-min sandbox to test Redwood". I'll write two micro-variants.
Dylan Park: A/B test variant allocation 50/50 on docs cohort. Use utm_campaign=reactivate_q2 and utm_content=subjectA|subjectB.
Aisha Khan: Metrics & guardrails: open>28% & click>5% to scale. If click from enterprise domain, fire SDR webhook.
Marco Ruiz: Ops checklist:
```
- Build 2 email templates (announce + follow-up)
- Export segment: dormant_docs, dormant_trial
- Add UTM macros and poll links
- QA staging send to 50 internal
- Webhook for clicks -> CRM & SDR
```
send-bot: Dry run scheduled 2024-05-15 09:30 PT to staging-marketing (50 recipients). Reminder 10m prior.
Faye Chen: Note: keep images minimal, include plain-text fallback, and make sandbox CTA a single prominent button.
Dylan Park: Great. Faye drop copy by EOD, Marco will push templates & QA, Aisha sets segments and webhooks. We'll review dry-run metrics and decide ramp. :rocket:
